result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): Both answers give plausible values: a 68ch prose measure, a breakout grid for code and tables, scroll wrappers, and a docs shell with sidebar and table of contents. B builds more from its named tokens (the breakout width is calculated from them), says plainly that nothing grows past 1440px, and needs only three breakpoints, although its 4/8/12 column token is never used. A is more economical, with three breakpoints, and routes nearly all of its rules through named tokens, though it defines --layout-cols and never uses it.
